possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: The card states the model may still generate inappropriate, biased, or offensive content despite efforts to refine pretraining data, and it is a text-generation fine-tune on instruction/conversation data, so factually inaccurate or untruthful outputs are plausible.

possible_risks.description: In AI-assisted decision-making tasks, reliance measures how much a person trusts (and potentially acts on) a model's output. Over-reliance occurs when a person puts too much trust in a model, accepting a model's output when the model's output is likely incorrect. Under-reliance is the opposite, where the person doesn't trust the model but should.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports no safety or reliability evaluations beyond a generic caveat, and the model is an open-weight instruct-style assistant, so users may over-trust its outputs.

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card describes an open-weight conversational/instruct model with no stated safeguards or filtering of user inputs, so users may include confidential information in prompts.

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card describes an open-weight conversational/instruct model with no stated safeguards or filtering of user inputs, so users may include copyrighted or IP-protected material in prompts.

training_context.adaptations: The model is a hybrid explain-and-instruct style fine-tune of Llama2-13b, and it is subject to the original Llama-2 license and usage restrictions.
training_context.training_data: The model was fine-tuned on a mix of instruction and conversation datasets, including Open-Platypus, Alpaca, WizardLM, Dolly-V2, Dolphin Samples, Orca_minis_v1, and Orca-style variants of Alpaca, WizardLM, and Dolly-V2.
